findings.description: This shard never uses its copy of `coverableFiles`. It was renamed `_coverableFiles` rather than deleted, which leaves dead code that lint can't flag. The open-pr shard dropped its unused copy, and the only nearby use (L1422) reads `typescriptAdapter.coverableFiles` instead.

The shards were split by runtime, but their names suggest topics they don't hold, so it isn't clear where a new test belongs: the decision-86 re-gating describe is in `merge-gate.test.ts` (L856), `the gate checkout` is in `merge-gate-open-pr.test.ts` (L284), and the decision-105 stale-branch-open-PR describe is in `merge-gate-regate.test.ts` (L1063). Either move the describes to match the names, or use neutral names with a one-line header saying the split is balanced by runtime.

These three shard files do not mirror a source file, but `testing.md` says one test file per source file. There is no `merge-gate-regate.service.ts`, `merge-gate-open-pr.service.ts` or `merge-gate-checkout.service.ts`.
